meta.descricao: Founded on {data} in Valejas, Barcarena. Valejas Atlético Clube began with athletics, cycling and malha, and today is home to seven sports.

cabecalho.texto: Valejas Atlético Clube was founded on <forte>{data}</forte>, in the village of {localidade}, in the parish of {freguesia}, municipality of {concelho}.

fundacao.p1: The club was born as a sports and recreation association rooted in the Valejas community. Over the years it took on a growing role in promoting sport across the whole parish of Barcarena.
fundacao.p2: Its origins lie above all in local sport, in neighbours spending time together and in creating activities for the people who live here — and that is what the club still is.

naoSabemos.texto: There is no public record of the founders' names, nor any minutes describing the exact moment the club was founded. If you have documents, photographs or family memories of the club's early days, get in touch — the history of Valejas is still waiting to be written properly.

comecou.texto: Long before futsal. The club's first activities were these three — two on legs and wheels, one for getting together outside the clubhouse.

atletismo.descricao: Organising and taking part in local races, including the Valejas Atlético Clube Athletics Grand Prix.

cicloturismo.descricao: Bike rides around the region and taking part in cycle touring events.

malha.descricao: Malha, a traditional Portuguese throwing game, and other traditional pastimes, tied to the village's festivities and everyday life.

depois: Futsal, now the club's flagship sport, with a professional team and a full youth set-up
Walking, dance, gymnastics and other social activities
The Senior Academy, for people aged 50 and over
comecou.nota: No exact dates — there's no record to pin them down. So this isn't a timeline: it's the order in which things happened.

ondeEstamos.texto: The clubhouse sits in the Jamor valley, between Barcarena and Queluz de Baixo. It has always been at the same address.

mapa.titulo: Map showing the location of Valejas Atlético Clube

resto.texto: The history is just the beginning. Today's club is in these pages.

emblema.descricao: The eagle, the colours and what each part of the crest means.

instalacoes.descricao: The clubhouse, the sports hall and what goes on there every day.

orgaos.descricao: Who runs the club: the Board, the Audit Committee and the General Assembly Board.

patrocinadores.descricao: The businesses and people who keep the club on its feet.

cta.texto: The club belongs to the people in it. Membership is €1 a month.

meta.descricao: The Valejas AC crest — the eagle, the yellow and blue colours and the story of a unique identity since 1966.

hero.texto: More than a symbol — a declaration of war. The Valejas Atlético Clube crest is the visual expression of our resilience, our heritage and the electric energy that runs through our stands.

aguia.texto: Our apex predator. The eagle doesn't just watch — it rules the skies over Valejas. It stands for the club's strategic vision and the ferocity with which we attack every match. It is our link to the sky and our boundless ambition.
aguia.citacao: “The sound of beating wings is the warning. Valejas never backs down.”
aguia.imagemAlt: The eagle from the Valejas Atlético Clube crest

amarelo.texto: The club's colour. The yellow of the shirt worn by generations of people from Valejas since 1966 — warm, vibrant and unmistakable on the pitch.

azul.texto: The loyalty and composure of those who represent Valejas, on and off the court. The depth of our commitment to the community.

nossas.texto: Yellow and blue — the colours of Valejas Atlético Clube since 1966, worn with pride by members, athletes and supporters. Simple and honest, like the place they represent.

meta.descricao: The Valejas Atlético Clube clubhouse and sports hall — where the club works, trains, plays and gets together.

cabecalho.texto: Two spaces, two roles. The clubhouse is where club business gets done and people meet; the sports hall is where we play.

instalacoes.semFotos: Photos of this space are still to be published.

sede.descricao: Valejas's meeting point. This is where the Board works, where registrations and membership cards are handled, and where the Senior Academy meets every afternoon.
usos: Sueca (a card game), billiards and socialising

pavilhao.descricao: Where futsal plays and trains, from the little ones to the first team. This is where the fifteen home matches of the district league are played.
usos: Training for Team A, Team B and the youth sides

cta.texto: The door is open. For registrations, questions, or just to see the club from the inside.

meta.descricao: The Board, the Audit Committee and the General Assembly Board of Valejas Atlético Clube — the people who run the club.

cabecalho.texto: The people who run the club. All of them are Valejas members, most of them for many years — some have been here since 1981.

direcao.descricao: Runs the club day to day — sports, facilities, members and finances. It signs the club's official notices.

conselhoFiscal.descricao: Audits the club's accounts and reports on them to the General Assembly.

mesaAssembleiaGeral.descricao: Calls and chairs the General Assemblies, where members decide the club's direction.

cta.texto: Official notices are published on the website and on the club's social media. For anything else, get in touch.

meta.descricao: Who supports Valejas Atlético Clube — main sponsor, institutional support, local businesses from the parish of Barcarena, and partners.

cabecalho.texto: A neighbourhood club can't keep going on its own. These are the businesses and institutions that put their shoulder to it — some kit out the teams, some open doors, some simply won't let us fall.

principal.intro: The one who kits out the club.

institucional.intro: The institutions of the area Valejas calls home.

local.intro: Local businesses that lend the club a hand.

parceria.intro: Those who put their craft at the club's service.

cta.texto: There are many ways to lend a hand to a club that's {anos} years old — from kitting out an age group to the snacks at a get-together. Talk to the Board.
